summary: Visa Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a September 18, 2026 authorization to deposit $405 million into its U.S. litigation escrow account under the retrospective responsibility plan. The deposit diluted class B-1, B-2, and B-3 conversion rates to 1.5400, 1.4924, and 1.4773, respectively, reducing as-converted share counts by roughly 9,804, 4,377, and 1,089,926 shares. There is no acquisition, tender, activist, or strategic-review event; the disclosure is an ordinary plan mechanics update, with no board recommendation or advisor named.
